entries.title: Psalms 2:1
segments: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples meditate on a vain thing?

entries.title: Psalms 2:2
segments: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers plot together, against the LORD and against His anointed, [saying],

entries.title: Psalms 2:3
segments: Let us break their bands in two and cast away their cords from us.

entries.title: Psalms 2:4
segments: He who sits in the heavens shall laugh; the LORD shall mock at them.

entries.title: Psalms 2:5
segments: Then He shall speak to them in His anger, and trouble them in His wrath.

entries.title: Psalms 2:6
segments: Yea, I have set My king on My holy hill, on Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 2:7
segments: I will declare the decree of the LORD. He has said to Me, You [are] My Son; today I have begotten You.

entries.title: Psalms 2:8
segments: Ask of Me, and I shall give the nations [for] Your inheritance; and the uttermost parts of the earth for Your possession.

entries.title: Psalms 2:9
segments: You shall break them with a rod of iron; You shall dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

entries.title: Psalms 2:10
segments: And now be wise, O kings; be instructed, O judges of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 2:11
segments: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

entries.title: Psalms 2:12
segments: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry, and you perish [from] the way, when His wrath is kindled in but a little time. Blessed [are] all who put their trust in Him.
